versions.content: Reporting successful Memory Write operation to IdsM In case a diagnostic service WriteMemoryByAddress is received, which results in a positive response, the Dcm shall report a security event SEV_UDS_WRITE_MEMORY_SUCCESSFUL to IdsM (see [11] and table [SWS_Dcm_01751]) with the context data given in [SWS_Dcm_01751].
